name: march_1997_endpoint_assumption
description: Treat the observed 27 March 1997 close as the March endpoint for DT, GS, LX and SS, restoring March and April returns. This is a separate sensitivity, not an amendment to the preserved primary data policy.
source_evidence: Raw closes exist on the specified dates; public-holiday evidence corroborates Easter timing, but exact 1997 venue closure evidence and vendor identity are unverified.
